name: Email Intake Agent
description: Acts on one specific mailbox message at a time, as directed by the supervisor: downloads attachments and marks it read for a message already classified as valid, or just marks it read if the supervisor classified it as invalid/out-of-scope.

skills.name: Process Email Message
skills.description: Downloads attachments for one specific message the supervisor has classified as valid (in this pipeline's scope), marks it read, and returns an intake record.

skills.name: Mark Email Invalid
skills.description: Marks one specific message read without processing it -- the supervisor has classified it as invalid/out-of-scope for this pipeline.
examples: Mark this out-of-scope email as read

metadata.boundary: Per-message mailbox action: attachment retrieval, read-state, on the supervisor's instruction
metadata.background: No longer runs its own poller -- the supervisor (client/orchestrator/email_polling.py) owns mailbox listing and the valid/invalid classification, and calls one of this agent's two skills per message
metadata.recreatedFrom: ennvault-claude-backend/email_module (poll.py, service.py) and mcp_servers/common/graph_client.py used only as a functional reference
